title: Flash flood warnings, fed raises rates | FOX 10 Phoenix
text:
Heavy rainfall across Arizona brought severe flash flood risks. Plus, the Federal Reserve announced its first interest rate increase in more than three years, raising rates by a quarter point. New developments emerge regarding a juror in the Karen Read trial, as a retired FBI Special Agent discusses the juror's past domestic violence allegations.
